title: github.pull_request.merge v1 arguments
description: Merge one approved pull request at exactly head_sha into base. The repository is only the effect target. Always high risk, with a distinct authorized owner and WebAuthn step-up. Re-read before dispatch; send the SHA precondition with GitHub merge_action=default and bypass_rules=false. Repository merge queues and rules remain authoritative. A queued or pending response is not success: Observe requires merged=true, an exact head/base/repository match, and a merge commit SHA. merge_method applies only to direct merges; a queue uses its configured method. UTF-8, no duplicate keys and a 65536-byte document limit.

x-helm.idempotent: conditional: exact PR number and head SHA, authoritative readback before retry
x-helm.observable: yes: merged flag, head SHA, base, repository and merge commit readback
x-helm.approval: always requires an authorized owner and WebAuthn step-up; no documentation-only exception
